inspection: Read-only managed IL inspection using dnfile 0.18.0 and dncil 1.0.2 installed in /tmp/stardew-sr-il; no game writes.

findings.evidence: Stardew Valley 1.6.15 Utility.AOrAn returns a/an for mod locales (only special case Hungarian az), unlike Lexicon.getProperArticleForWord which returns empty outside en. Multiplayer.receiveChatInfoMessage uses Utility.AOrAn for aOrAn: tokens.
findings.requiredChange: Add a Harmony postfix scoped exactly to mod + sr-vnrevival which returns empty from Utility.AOrAn; preserve every other locale. Integrate and build shared switcher when registering sr. Test both Serbian suppression and unchanged other locales, plus direct VN switching.
findings.implementation: VN Revival Language Switcher 1.5.0 patches Utility.AOrAn only for active mod locale sr-vnrevival; shared-source probe verifies Serbian suppression and unchanged non-Serbian behavior.

findings.evidence: PondQueryMenu.UpdateState uses getProperArticleForWord for count <=1, then OneCount if article empty. For sr custom language this is empty; {1} can thus be мало. Parenthetical quantity handles both words and numbers without inflecting display name.
Possessive_Pronoun_Male=његов; Possessive_Pronoun_Female=њен used before nominative дом. Verify all other insertion contexts before accepting Lexicon.

CharacterCustomization.optionButtonClick passes Lexicon.getProperArticleForWord(itemName) to argument 0 and itemName to argument 1 of NameChange_EasterEgg6. Article is already empty for sr mod language.
Dialogue.checkForSpecialCharacters independently substitutes the 20 random adjectives and 23 random nouns. Serbian adjectives are stored in masculine nominative while 13 nouns are feminine.
findings.implementation: The locale-scoped Harmony prefix/postfix runs only when an input contains both %adj and %noun under sr-vnrevival. SerbianGrammar classifies all 23 nouns and inflects all 20 adjectives, preserving masculine forms and initial capitalization.
findings.verification: Scripts/test-serbian-language-switcher.sh compiled the shared production grammar source and passed all 460 adjective/noun combinations, word-boundary cases, capitalization, Serbian article suppression, and non-Serbian preservation.
